name: nucleus
description: Nucleus — one operating system of portable AI workflows and shared memory for Claude, ChatGPT, and Codex.

plugins.name: claude-cortex
plugins.description: A host-portable Markdown second brain shared by Claude, ChatGPT Work, and Codex.

plugins.name: weekly-alignment
plugins.description: Scan configured Slack sources for cross-team alignment signals and produce daily pulses, weekly reports, and risk updates.

plugins.name: core-ops
plugins.description: Natural-language chief-of-staff front door (/cos, replaces nucleus-router), CRM pipeline analysis, Nucleus health diagnostics, agent metrics, and schedule registration when the host supports them.

plugins.name: news-curator
plugins.description: Find recent stories, rank them for a configured audience, and assemble a voice-matched roundup with traceable sources.

plugins.name: delivery
plugins.description: Client engagement lifecycle: start, status, QA. Create an engagement plan, portable AI workspace prompt, folder blueprint, and next action; draft weekly client-status updates; run structured brand/quality QA on deliverables before you ship. Renamed from project-setup, 2026-09-15 — absorbs client-status and core-ops's review-deliverable.

plugins.name: time-tracking
plugins.description: Turn calendar events into a local, reviewable time log and generate invoice drafts from configured client billing rules.

plugins.name: relationships
plugins.description: Build a daily relationship cockpit, rebalance a network, and create context-aware touchpoint drafts from shared identity, voice, and memory. Absorbs lead-engine (Apollo signal pipeline) and referral-engine (referral asks + cooling rules) as of 2026-09-15.

plugins.name: voice
plugins.description: Create voice-matched drafts, compare drafts with final edits, and propose durable style-rule updates only after repeated evidence. Renamed from writing-style, 2026-09-15.

plugins.name: daily-brief
plugins.description: Combine calendar, tasks, outreach, inbox, CRM, and Cortex context into a daily brief, then process user-approved annotations and plan tomorrow.
